notes.title: Time to put on your party hats and blow up those balloons!
notes.content:
* Time to put on your party hats and blow up those balloons, because it's BIRTHDAY SEASON! With our all new Game Icon, get ready to deck out your restaurant with our colorful, sparkling, and whimsical Birthday-themed Seasonal Decors. 
* On popular demand, KITCHEN KLASH is now also available in an exciting MINI-GAME format! Flaunt your skills and conquer challenges in your favourite cooking competition- now more accessible and addictive than ever. Read, set, cook!
* Hold onto your chef hats because our Mini-Game REWARDS SHOWCASE just got shinier! Now swipe through your Mini-game Reward Lane to see all the upcoming rewards for your victories. So, get ready to reap your rewards in style because with clear visuals and more exciting presentations, you'll be motivated to play the mini-games again and again!

notes.title: Set sail on a culinary voyage with CRUISE PARTY

* Time to unleash your inner interior designer with our EDIT MODE Feature! Redecorating your restaurant has never been easier or more fun. With just a few taps, redesign your humble eatery smoothly and effortlessly!
* Say goodbye to brewing boosters and hello to INSTANT ACTIVATION in our revamped Cooking Lab! Now, with just a snap of your fingers, unleash the power of BOOSTERS instantly while enjoying an extra slot for Premium Users with just Elixirs.
* Get ready to spice things up in the Kitchen Klash: SOLO TOURNAMENT! Get ready to conquer clear goals for kitchen glory.
